source_quote: Average new home prices declined by 0.21% m-o-m in March, narrowing from a 0.28% decrease in February.
Existing home prices, which might better reflect the trend of home prices in China, declined by 0.24% m-o-m in March, narrowing from the 0.43% decrease recorded in February.
By city tier, the change of average existing home prices in tier-1 cities turned positive in March, the first time in a year, rising to 0.4% m-o-m in March from -0.1% in February.
